source.title: Richard Durrett, Essentials of Stochastic Processes, Third Edition, 2016
source.pdf_filename: Essentials of Stochastic Processes (Richard Durrett) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

scope.source: 六章正文、全部236道习题及附录A逐章、逐题对照；版本与页码沿用source_manifest.json。
scope.exercises: 逐项检查题设、全部小问、分母、边界、单位、矩阵和支付；解答重新推导并扩写，计算结果代回，证明列条件及极限依据。
scope.body: 六章及附录A的正常编号示例均关联到实际推导；按各小节展开模型、主要公式、定理条件与证明。新增59组推导，合并重复段落后保留18组独立证明与校注。
scope.programs: 7 strict C11 and sanitizer builds; 159 independent numeric cases; 46 exact-status invalid inputs; four fixed-seed plus 12 extra-seed simulations; CRR convergence; source-page and tooling regressions.
scope.distinction: 纯数学证明按原书与逐步论证核对；数值程序通过有限基准与运行检查，两种证据分别记录。
scope.annotations: 作者的中文伴读说明：模型理解、公式含义、定理假设、简短补充推导、读法和验算。每条注解绑定原有小节；正文中的完整证明与习题详细步骤保留原位置。
scope.preface_and_formal_statements: 新增序言英文全文及逐段中文译文；六章及附录按实际原书标题覆盖115条编号定理/引理与两条编号定义，补写基础定义、三条概率公理和未编号公式。各条集中给出条件、结论、推导要点、源页及详细正文推导入口。

content_binding.scope: Reviewed text, formulas, quotes, page links and structure. Program bodies are checked against standalone sources separately. Snapshot equality is a change guard, not a mathematical proof.

program_checks.check_scope: HTML/source consistency, reviewed-content change guard, numeric references and execution. These checks do not prove all translated statements or mathematical arguments.

source_page_number_check.scope: Number and starting-page correspondence; translated text and proofs require mathematical/source review.

additional_seed_checks.scope: Isolated seed substitutions; original displayed fixed-seed sources remain unchanged. Finite statistical checks do not prove distributional correctness.

body_algebra_checks.scope: 确切算术、符号恒等式和关键修订位置；一般概率定理的证明仍按条件与原书论证核对。

runtime_evidence.scope: 7 strict C11 and sanitizer builds; 159 independent numeric cases; 46 exact-status invalid inputs; four fixed-seed plus 12 extra-seed simulations; CRR convergence; source-page and tooling regressions.
